title: Embedded C Mastery: From Application Developer to Firmware Engineer
description: Transition from high-level programming to bare-metal embedded systems. This intermediate-to-advanced course covers the Embedded C mindset, memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, linker scripts, and RTOS fundamentals. Learn to write safe, deterministic firmware for ARM Cortex-M and other microcontrollers without the safety net of an OS. Ideal for Python, JavaScript, and game developers moving into IoT and hardware.
